1.consolidated_definition: Tenis de mesa. Deporte similar al tenis que se juega sobre una mesa. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Véase ping pong. Nosotros queríamos ofrecerles en el Centro de Estudiantes toda esa cosa que el estudiante, no solamente al estudiante que se queda en los hospedaje aquí, sino el estudiante que vive en la zona metropolitana, y va y viene, en sus horas libres pues podría entrar allí, podía jugar pinpon, billar, bolos, escuchar música, ver obras de teatro, entretenerse, con programas tales como digamos un quiz-show, donde se premia el intelecto (Norma Culta 1990, XII)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Table tennis. A sport similar to tennis played on a table. Anglicism adapted, infrequently used. See ping pong.

We wanted to offer them at the Student Center all that thing which the student, not only the student who stays in the boarding house here, but also the student who lives in the metropolitan area and comes and goes, could enter during their free time, play ping pong, billiards, bowling, listen to music, watch theater performances, entertain themselves with programs such as a quiz show where intellectual merit is rewarded (Norma Culta 1990, XII)
